Trident

A Java test automation framework covering web, mobile and API testing behind a single Cucumber runner. The source, the documentation and the decision records are at github.com/cozgur/trident.

facts.json holds the numbers this project's CI measured on its last run, so anything that quotes them reads them from the build rather than repeating a figure written by hand.

The test report covers the same run: the smoke, api and web suites in one Allure report. A failing scenario carries its evidence with it — a screenshot, the page source and the HTTP exchange — and a passing one carries nothing, which is why the report is worth opening when it is red.
